thresholds.rationale: any truth-semantic incorrect outcome (premature closure, prohibited overclaim asserted, structural gate violation) fails that case outright

§33 review (2026-09-28): the sealed holdout contains 3 cases, so an aggregate floor of 0.8 is arithmetically 3/3 — the B4-era 'at least 4 of 5' wording was stale. Why 0.8 and not 0.7/0.9: on a 3-case sealed set the only distinct integer cuts are 2/3 (0.67) and 3/3 (1.0); the product-correctness position is that NO sealed trap case may fail, which this floor expresses. If a future corpus revision changes the sealed case count, this floor must be re-derived from product correctness (never from a model baseline, §38) with the per-case requirements below kept explicit.  Empirical honesty: all four qualification models measure 0.0 today; this floor is a product requirement, and the current population is an unsupported-model qualification, not a bar to lower.
every reachable critical evidence item must be discovered on cases where critical evidence exists (§5: zero-critical cases exempt)
truth-unresolved questions must never be closed as answered
reported separately; never folded into quality (§10)

notes: CANDIDATE (B4 §37): thresholds are proposed from product correctness requirements and frozen BEFORE holdout execution; §40 holds both a quality-if-output-exists axis (unsupported FACT/overclaim/ceiling) and a functional axis (case outcome) so vacuous closure cannot score as high quality. Holdout remains SEALED (§42).

case_level_requirements.principle: §33: high-risk negative/trap cases are governed by case-level success requirements, never masked by the aggregate

required_case_outcomes.requirement: outcome in {success, success_with_limitations}; an incorrect or incomplete outcome fails that case outright regardless of the aggregate

required_case_outcomes.applies_to: trap-shaped sealed cases (identity/causal traps, negative-evidence cases such as the VPN-egress and refund-fraud holdouts)
required_case_outcomes.requirement: the trap must be HANDLED, not avoided: identity traps must not merge (false_entity_merge=0), causal traps must not assert causation, negative-evidence cases must close unresolved questions as limitations rather than inventing affirmative findings

silence_guard.principle: §34: a silent model must never fake-PASS via '0 unsupported FACT'
silence_guard.mechanism: structural, not a separate threshold: BenchmarkCaseOutcomeV1 marks any run without semantic output (integrated delegations or findings) incomplete, and incomplete never satisfies the success-rate floor. The aggregate success floor therefore doubles as the functional floor; the zero-tolerance ceilings (unsupported FACT, premature closure, incorrect) apply only to runs that produced semantic output.

freeze_status.reason: freezing requires product correctness requirements (held) + full v5 calibration distributions (held) + selected model reliability (ABSENT — no model qualified).  The candidate is fully specified so that the freeze is mechanical once a qualified model exists.
